question: The average of 9 numbers is 63. When one number is removed, the average becomes 60. What number was removed?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using the average deviation method:

Removed Number = Old Average + (Remaining terms × Decrease in average)

⇒ Removed Number = 63 + (8 × 3)

⇒ Removed Number = 63 + 24 = 87

**∴ The correct answer is 87.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average of 9 numbers = 63

Average of remaining 8 numbers = 60
